brief: Śuka the parrot on Dādī's shoulder squawking beside the carved temple door, a hand held up in front of his open beak to feel the puff of air; Dādī covering her ears, amused; a lavender shadow giggling in the carving.

alt.en: A parrot squawks beside a carved door while a grandmother covers her ears
alt.hi: नक्काशीदार द्वार के पास चिल्लाता तोता, कान ढकती दादी

brief: The sandstone temple's carved wooden door at dusk: five rows of Devanagari-like carved letters across it, a small lavender shadow half hidden in the carving, you seen from behind with Dādī and Śuka on her shoulder.

alt.en: A carved temple door with five rows of letters and a shy shadow hiding in the carving
alt.hi: पाँच पंक्तियों में अक्षर खुदा नक्काशीदार मंदिर द्वार, जिसमें शर्मीली छाया छिपी है

brief: Close-up of the carved door below its five rows: one extra line of four letters set slightly apart, two lavender eyes glinting from the carving beside them, Dādī's finger pointing.

alt.en: A line of four carved letters under five rows, with two eyes glinting beside them
alt.hi: पाँच पंक्तियों के नीचे चार खुदे अक्षर, पास में चमकती दो आँखें

brief: The last carved line of the temple door with four letters; Śuka hissing with his beak narrowed, Dādī pointing at the letters, a lavender shadow laughing in the open, no longer hiding.

alt.en: A parrot hissing at four carved letters while a shy shadow laughs
alt.hi: चार खुदे अक्षरों पर फुफकारता तोता, खुलकर हँसती छाया

brief: Dādī's finger resting on one carved letter of the temple door that has a small slanted stroke at its foot; Chāyikā, a slim lavender shadow with a gold thread in her hair, standing in the open beside her and nodding.

alt.en: A grandmother's finger on a carved letter with a stroke at its foot, beside a nodding shadow
alt.hi: पाँव पर रेखा वाले खुदे अक्षर पर दादी की उँगली

brief: A tall carved stone pillar in the temple courtyard covered in crowded joined Devanagari-style letters; curled up in the carving a sleeping pale sage-green round spirit with a tiny nightcap of mist; you, Dādī and Śuka looking up at it.

alt.en: A stone pillar crowded with joined letters and a sleeping green spirit in a nightcap
alt.hi: संयुक्ताक्षरों से भरा पत्थर का स्तम्भ और टोपी पहने सोया हरा भूत

brief: The pillar with two carved marks highlighted, a single dot above one letter and a pair of dots after another; the sleeping green spirit humming, with tiny wavy lines of sound drifting from his nose and a puff of breath from his mouth.

alt.en: A pillar with a dot above one letter and two dots after another, and a sleeping spirit humming and sighing
alt.hi: एक बिन्दु और दो बिन्दुओं वाला स्तम्भ, गुनगुनाता सोया भूत

brief: The foot of the temple pillar with carved marks: a small avagraha curl, a tall single bar and a double bar, the sacred Om sign, and a row of Devanagari numerals; the green spirit stirring awake above them, Dādī pointing.

alt.en: The foot of a pillar with carved marks, the Om sign and numbers, and a spirit stirring
alt.hi: चिह्नों, ॐ और अंकों वाला स्तम्भ का पाँव, हिलता हुआ भूत

brief: The stone pillar in close-up with several joined letters containing the letter ra in different forms, a small curl above one and a hook below another; Śuka on Dādī's shoulder cross-eyed with effort; the sleeping green spirit mumbling in the background.

alt.en: A pillar with joined letters containing many shapes of ra, and a parrot cross-eyed with effort
alt.hi: र के कई रूपों वाला स्तम्भ और जीभ उलझाता तोता

brief: Dādī reading a letter written in Roman letters with dots and bars over them, beside the register; Śuka peering at it upside down; the tall silent spirit leaning in; warm lamplight.

alt.en: A grandmother reads a letter in Roman letters with dots and bars while a parrot peers at it
alt.hi: बिन्दु और रेखा वाले रोमन अक्षरों का पत्र पढ़ती दादी

brief: Dādī setting a small brass hand mirror on the low reading desk beside the register; the pale-gold spirit Maunī pointing from the register to his own mouth; Śuka on the shelf looking at himself in the mirror.

alt.en: A grandmother sets a brass mirror on a desk while a silent spirit points to his mouth
alt.hi: पीतल का दर्पण रखती दादी और अपने मुँह की ओर इशारा करता भूत

brief: The temple library's arched doorway: a tall man in an expensive dark coat over a kurta with rings on his fingers and a leather satchel stands half in shadow, watching the glowing leaf on the desk; in the foreground Dādī reads the open register to you and Maunī.

alt.en: A tall man in a dark coat watches from a library doorway as a grandmother reads a register
alt.hi: दरवाज़े से देखता गहरे कोट वाला आदमी, रजिस्टर पढ़ती दादी

brief: The temple library: Dādī lowers a huge cloth-bound register onto the low reading desk; between the shelves a tall thin pale-gold spirit stands with one finger to his lips and a scroll under his arm; you and Śuka watching.

alt.en: A grandmother lowers a huge register while a tall pale-gold spirit stands with a finger to his lips
alt.hi: विशाल रजिस्टर उतारती दादी और होंठों पर उँगली रखे सुनहरा भूत

brief: A procession returning through a lamplit village lane: the Ācārya with a lamp, the rescued pupil wrapped in Dādī's shawl, you and Śuka beside them; a faint blue-grey echo-spirit walking quietly alongside; the school gate ahead.

alt.en: A group walking home through a lamplit lane with a rescued pupil and an echo-spirit
alt.hi: दीपक की रोशनी में गली से घर लौटता समूह, बचाया हुआ शिष्य और गूँज-भूत

brief: A narrow dark village lane at night, whitewashed walls lit by the small lamp you carry, Dādī beside you with a hand cupped to her mouth calling; a faint blue-grey ripple-shaped spirit with ear-like curls peeking from behind a wall; Śuka on your shoulder with his head cocked.

alt.en: Two people with a lamp calling down a dark village lane while a faint echo-spirit peeks from a wall
alt.hi: अँधेरी गली में दीपक लेकर पुकारते दो लोग और दीवार से झाँकता गूँज-भूत

brief: A small village ghat with a whitewashed school among neem trees above it; at the gate a very old scholar with a white beard and a palm-leaf book under his arm, smiling; you, Dādī and Śuka coming up the steps with fruit, a lamp and a length of cloth; a small golden spirit with cupped hands following.

alt.en: Arriving at a village school where an old scholar waits at the gate
alt.hi: गाँव की पाठशाला पर पहुँचना, फाटक पर प्रतीक्षा करते बूढ़े आचार्य

brief: The courtyard of a village school with a neem tree and children at their slates; the old Ācārya walking beside you and Dādī, listening with a raised hand; Śuka on a low wall; the small golden spirit trailing with a grain of rice in his palms.

alt.en: An old teacher leads visitors through a school courtyard
alt.hi: पाठशाला के आँगन में अतिथियों को ले जाते वृद्ध आचार्य

brief: A sudden storm at the river: leaves torn from the neem trees, boats straining at their ropes, children running toward the school, the old Ācārya waving everyone away from the water; in the whirl of wind a swirling grey-green spirit made of leaves and gust dancing.

alt.en: A storm sweeps the riverbank as everyone runs for the school
alt.hi: नदी तट पर आँधी और पाठशाला की ओर भागते सब लोग

brief: Children huddled together in a lamplit school hall while a storm hammers the shutters, a small girl clinging to the old Ācārya who sits among them; at the window a grinning grey-green spirit pressing its face against the shutter slats.

alt.en: Children huddle in a school hall during a storm with a grinning wind spirit at the window
alt.hi: आँधी में पाठशाला के कक्ष में दुबके बच्चे और खिड़की पर मुस्कुराता पवन-भूत

brief: The puppeteer's wife at her stall holding up a sweet fruit, a sweet cake and a doll of a pretty girl while Dādī listens with a raised finger; the small rainbow-coloured spirit on a lamp changing colour.

alt.en: A stall-keeper describing her wares while a small colour-changing spirit watches
alt.hi: अपना सामान बखानती दुकानदार और रंग बदलता नन्हा भूत

brief: A garland-maker sitting under a banyan tree at the fair with a basket of flowers, a trailing white jasmine vine and her small daughter pointing at the river; Śuka tugging at a flower; the rainbow-coloured spirit hiding in the basket.

alt.en: A garland-maker under a banyan tree with her small daughter
alt.hi: बरगद के नीचे माला वाली और उसकी छोटी बेटी

brief: Śuka on Dādī's shoulder pointing a wing at three puppets in turn: a king, a queen and a golden crown; the puppeteer's wife laughing and holding up the crown; the small rainbow-coloured spirit peeking.

alt.en: A parrot points at a king, a queen and a crown puppet in turn
alt.hi: राजा, रानी और मुकुट की कठपुतली की ओर बारी-बारी इशारा करता तोता

brief: A sweet-seller's brass tray heaped with sweets at the fair; the boatman, the old man and Dādī each pointing at a different one, near and far; Śuka perched on the tray's edge eyeing a sweet.

alt.en: People at a sweet stall pointing at different sweets, near and far
alt.hi: मिठाई की थाली पर पास और दूर की अलग-अलग चीज़ें दिखाते लोग

brief: A riverside village fair: strings of paper flags, sweet sellers, a wooden wheel and a puppet booth with a red curtain where a puppeteer holds up a king, a queen and a golden crown puppet; you, Dādī and Śuka in the crowd, a small rainbow-coloured spirit peeping from behind the curtain.

alt.en: A puppet booth at a village fair with a king, a queen and a crown
alt.hi: मेले में राजा, रानी और मुकुट वाली कठपुतली मंडली

brief: The boat on the open river with five aboard: you, Dādī, Śuka, the boatman at the pole, the white-bearded old man, and the silvery spirit sitting on the gunwale, all turned toward one another as if introducing themselves; soft morning light on the water.

alt.en: Passengers introducing themselves aboard a river boat
alt.hi: नदी की नाव में अपना परिचय देते सवार

brief: A grid of nine glowing words laid out in light on the surface of the river, three rows by three columns, rippling; the boat drifting through it, you and Dādī leaning over the side to read it; the silvery spirit spreading his arms over the water.

alt.en: A grid of nine glowing verb forms on the river water
alt.hi: नदी के जल पर चमकती नौ क्रियाओं की तालिका

brief: A long wooden river boat nosing up to the ghat steps; a lean sun-browned boatman in a faded blue dhoti leaning on his bamboo pole and smiling; you, Dādī and Śuka on the steps; the small grey-blue spirit hanging back behind you.

alt.en: A boatman leaning on his pole beside a boat at the ghat steps
alt.hi: घाट की सीढ़ियों पर नाव के पास डंडी पर झुका नाविक

brief: A white-bearded old man being helped into the boat at a bend of the river by the boatman, Dādī whispering to you with a finger raised, Śuka bowing his head, the silver spirit peering over the side.

alt.en: An old man is helped into the boat while Dādī whispers advice
alt.hi: बुज़ुर्ग को नाव में चढ़ाते नाविक और कान में सलाह देती दादी

brief: The boat sliding out from the ghat steps with you, Dādī, Śuka, the boatman and the small silvery spirit aboard; Dādī turned toward the spirit with a kind direct look as if speaking to him.

alt.en: A grandmother speaks kindly to a small spirit as the boat leaves the ghat
alt.hi: नाव के घाट छोड़ते समय नन्हे भूत से कोमलता से बोलती दादी

brief: The Ācārya counting on his fingers in the lamplit house, four small scenes above him: dawn reading, noon meal, evening singing, night sleeping; the flame-shaped spirit flickering a different colour for each; Dādī nodding.

alt.en: An old teacher counts the hours of the day on his fingers while a flame-spirit changes colour
alt.hi: दिन के पहर उँगलियों पर गिनते आचार्य और रंग बदलता लौ-भूत

brief: The school courtyard at night: the old Ācārya hanging a lit brass lamp beside a stone well, pupils in a ring, a small flickering amber spirit shaped like a flame leaping up from the lamp; stars overhead; you and Dādī at the edge.

alt.en: Night in a school courtyard, a lamp hung by the well and a flame-shaped spirit leaping up
alt.hi: आँगन में रात, कुएँ पर टँगा दीपक और उछलता लौ-भूत

brief: The school library: tall shelves of palm-leaf bundles tied with coloured threads, a low reading desk with Dādī's open notebook; beside the desk a small tree of green mist hung with tiny leaf-shaped name tags, standing up; you and Śuka looking on.

alt.en: A library with a small tree of green mist hung with name-tags standing beside a desk
alt.hi: नाम-पत्तों वाला हरे धुंध का नन्हा पेड़ पुस्तकालय में मेज़ के पास

brief: The tree of green mist with a third thick branch bowing toward the desk, tags rustling; Śuka scattering three tags with his wing and reading them aloud proudly; Dādī laughing; you copying into a notebook.

alt.en: A parrot reads tags from the third branch of a tree of names
alt.hi: नामों के पेड़ की तीसरी शाखा के टैग पढ़ता तोता

brief: The tree of green mist in the library with a second lower branch hung with a different set of leaf-tags, Dādī pointing to it with her pen and comparing it to the upper branch; Śuka on a shelf pulling at a tag.

alt.en: A tree of name-tags with two branches, one pointing to the other
alt.hi: दो शाखाओं वाला नाम-पत्तों का पेड़, एक शाखा की ओर इशारा

brief: The school library at night, moonlight through a window: a small blue-black spirit with ink-stained wisps writing in the air with a reed pen, faint glowing lines of verse trailing behind it; you, Dādī and Śuka peering round a shelf; the tree of names glowing softly in a corner.

alt.en: An ink-stained spirit writing glowing verse in the air in a moonlit library
alt.hi: चाँदनी में पुस्तकालय में हवा पर चमकते श्लोक लिखता स्याही से सना भूत

brief: A library shelf at the end of an aisle with two small glowing figures of mist: a river-shaped ripple and a veiled bride; the ink-stained spirit sweeping its pen over them so that their outlines ripple like water; Dādī pointing and explaining.

alt.en: Two glowing mist figures, a river and a bride, on a library shelf as a poet-spirit sweeps his pen over them
alt.hi: पुस्तकालय की अलमारी पर दो चमकते धुंध-आकार: नदी और वधू

brief: The last library shelf with small mist figures of a father, a mother, a brother and a giver holding out his hands; the ink-stained spirit hopping onto the shelf and waving its pen; Śuka murmuring family words like a lullaby; Dādī listening.

alt.en: A shelf of mist figures of kin, a father, a mother, a brother and a giver
alt.hi: अलमारी पर नातों की धुंध-आकृतियाँ: पिता, माता, भाई और दाता

brief: The Ācārya tiptoeing into the library with a lamp and bowing gravely to Śuka who has puffed himself up on a shelf; Dādī suppressing a laugh; the ink-stained blue-black spirit waving its pen at the next shelf.

alt.en: An old teacher bows gravely to a puffed-up parrot in a library
alt.hi: फूले हुए तोते को गम्भीरता से प्रणाम करते बूढ़े आचार्य

brief: The round spice seller with arms folded firing questions at the small yellow spirit, who shrinks behind your leg; Dādī holding up four fingers; Śuka cocking his head; spice heaps in the foreground.

alt.en: A spice seller fires questions at a shy yellow spirit
alt.hi: मसाले वाला शर्मीले पीले भूत पर प्रश्न दागता है

brief: The spice seller sitting behind his stall with a very old green-lidded wooden chest at his feet, shaking his head with a smile; the small yellow spirit hovering above the lid; you and Dādī looking at it with curiosity.

alt.en: A spice seller shakes his head over an old chest while a spirit hovers above it
alt.hi: पुराने संदूक पर सिर हिलाता मसाले वाला और ऊपर मँडराता भूत

brief: A riverside market under striped awnings: baskets of fruit, heaps of red and yellow spice, swinging brass scales; a small saffron-yellow spirit darting between stalls pointing at things, a round cheerful spice seller watching him, you, Dādī and Śuka among the shoppers.

alt.en: A busy market with a small yellow spirit pointing at everything
alt.hi: व्यस्त बाज़ार, हर चीज़ की ओर इशारा करता नन्हा पीला भूत

brief: The small saffron-yellow spirit tugging at your sleeve and pointing between the spice stall, the river and a grove of trees beyond the market; Dādī smiling; Śuka looking where he points.

alt.en: A small spirit tugging a sleeve and pointing in three directions
alt.hi: तीन दिशाओं में इशारा करते हुए आस्तीन खींचता नन्हा भूत

brief: Dādī on the floor mat of the Ācārya's lamplit house drawing a family tree in her cloth-bound notebook with a reed pen, a trunk with many named branches; you leaning over her shoulder; the slim golden spirit's lamp glowing brighter as each name is read; Śuka on the shelf.

alt.en: A grandmother draws a family tree in her notebook while a golden spirit's lamp brightens
alt.hi: कॉपी में वंशवृक्ष बनाती दादी और उज्ज्वल होता भूत का दीपक

brief: The Ācārya's small, lamplit house behind the school: a low desk with a palm-leaf book, a reed pen, a folded saffron shawl and a string of beads; a slim warm-gold spirit holding a tiny lamp touching each thing softly; you and Dādī sitting on the floor mat.

alt.en: A slim golden spirit with a tiny lamp touches old belongings in a teacher's house
alt.hi: आचार्य के घर में पुरानी चीज़ों को छूता दीपक थामे भूत

brief: The small grey-blue spirit arranging word-cards into three sentences on the ghat steps, shaking his head at one wrong one that Śuka placed; Dādī watching with arms folded and a smile.

alt.en: A small spirit rejects a mismatched sentence while a parrot grins
alt.hi: बेमेल वाक्य पर सिर हिलाता भूत और मुस्कुराता तोता

brief: The ghat crowded with many boats pulling up to the steps, each with its boatman calling out, a small grey-blue spirit cupping his hands as if announcing them; Dādī and Śuka watching from the steps.

alt.en: Many boats crowding the ghat steps
alt.hi: घाट की सीढ़ियों पर भीड़ लगाती अनेक नावें

brief: Two tall white herons standing side by side on one leg each in the shallows of the river at the ghat, perfectly mirrored in the water; Śuka on Dādī's shoulder counting on his claw; boats beginning to gather behind.

alt.en: Two white herons standing side by side in the river shallows
alt.hi: उथले पानी में साथ-साथ खड़े दो सफ़ेद बगुले

brief: Three groups of readers on the ghat steps: one boy reading alone, two girls sharing a palm leaf, and a row of children reading aloud together; the small grey-blue spirit leaning in with a hand cupped to his ear.

alt.en: One reader, two readers and a row of readers on the ghat steps
alt.hi: एक पाठक, दो पाठक और पाठकों की पंक्ति

brief: Ganaka the knotted-cord spirit tying knots in a long cord with great pride, a row of old palm leaves laid out on a low table; Dādī laughing; Śuka counting on his claws; lamplight.

alt.en: A cord spirit ties knots to count a row of old leaves while Dādī laughs
alt.hi: डोरी का भूत गाँठें लगाकर पुराने पत्रों की पंक्ति गिन रहा, दादी हँसती हुई

brief: The inner room of the village school library at morning: the Ācārya unlocking a carved door; high on a shelf a small grey spirit made of knotted cords and pebbles pointing at rows of books and muttering; Dādī and Śuka looking up at it; sunbeams full of dust.

alt.en: A knotted-cord spirit on a high library shelf points at rows of books while Dādī and a parrot look up
alt.hi: ऊँची अलमारी पर गाँठदार डोरियों का भूत पुस्तकों की ओर इशारा करता, दादी और तोता ऊपर देखते

brief: Dādī and the knotted-cord spirit at a low table: on a clay slate a ladder of written numbers and a circle of a day cut into eight slices, half bright and half dark; Śuka looking at the slate; Dādī pointing.

alt.en: Dādī draws a day cut into eight watches on a clay slate beside the cord spirit
alt.hi: दादी पाटी पर आठ पहरों में कटा दिन खींचती हुई, पास में डोरी का भूत

brief: The library at morning: the knotted-cord spirit holding up a book and a question mark made of rope; Dādī tapping a shelf, Śuka whispering to you; sunbeams crossing the rows of books.

alt.en: A knotted-cord spirit holds up a book and a rope question mark in a library
alt.hi: गाँठदार डोरियों का भूत पुस्तक और रस्सी का प्रश्नचिह्न उठाए हुए

brief: The ghat steps full of morning life: a boy reading, a girl singing, a boatman resting beside his boat, a heron in the shallows; the small grey-blue spirit sweeping his arm over the scene while Dādī asks a question.

alt.en: A busy ghat with a reading boy, a singing girl, a boatman and a heron
alt.hi: व्यस्त घाट: पढ़ता बालक, गाती बालिका, नाविक और बगुला

brief: Four small scenes along the ghat steps: a boy reading, a girl writing on a slate, a heron standing, a boat gliding; Śuka on Dādī's shoulder squawking happily; the small spirit counting on his fingers.

alt.en: Four actions on the ghat with a parrot squawking along
alt.hi: घाट पर चार क्रियाएँ, साथ में चहकता तोता

brief: Dawn on the stone ghat steps of a calm river: people bathing, a boy reading on the steps, and on the lowest step a small grey-blue spirit like river mist with his feet in the water, pointing; you, Dādī and Śuka coming down the steps.

alt.en: Dawn at the river steps with a boy reading and a small mist-spirit pointing
alt.hi: भोर में नदी की सीढ़ियाँ: पढ़ता बालक और इशारा करता नन्हा भूत

brief: Dādī pointing first at a boy on the ghat steps and then at the small grey-blue spirit, as though introducing them; Śuka looking from one to the other; calm river light.

alt.en: A grandmother introduces a boy and a small spirit on the ghat
alt.hi: घाट पर बालक और नन्हे भूत का परिचय कराती दादी

brief: Śuka the parrot flapping happily as word-cards float in the air around him, the small grey-blue spirit juggling them, Dādī clapping on the ghat steps.

alt.en: A parrot and a small spirit juggling floating word-cards on the ghat
alt.hi: शब्द-पत्रों से खेलते तोता और नन्हा भूत

brief: A wooden river boat gliding downstream with you, Dādī, Śuka and the boatman poling it, the spice seller waving from the bank; Dādī writing with a reed pen in her notebook; beside the boat a small pale-blue spirit shaped like a curved boat riding the current.

alt.en: A boat gliding downstream with a small boat-shaped spirit riding beside it
alt.hi: धारा में चलती नाव और उसके बगल में नाव के आकार का नन्हा भूत

brief: The boat on a widening river with you, Dādī with her pen, Śuka on the awning and the boatman, the small boat-shaped spirit circling the boat; Dādī lifting one finger as if teaching.

alt.en: A boat with friends aboard on a widening river with a small spirit circling it
alt.hi: चौड़ी होती नदी में दोस्तों वाली नाव और उसके चारों ओर घूमता नन्हा भूत

brief: Deep in the grove at night: a single tiny golden spark flickering on and off in the dark with a thin trail of smoke; the Vetāla seated on a root watching it with a gentle expression; you, Dādī and Śuka kneeling to look; ancient gnarled trunks around.

alt.en: A tiny flickering spark in the dark of an old grove, watched gently by a grey spirit
alt.hi: पुराने वन के अँधेरे में एक नन्हा टिमटिमाता स्फुलिंग, कोमलता से देखता भूत

brief: The very edge of the old grove at night: four ancient grey spirits seated in a half-circle, faint and wise, like carved figures worn smooth by time; the Vetāla introducing them with an open hand; you, Dādī and Śuka standing respectfully in front.

alt.en: Four ancient grey spirits sit in a half-circle while the Vetāla introduces them
alt.hi: अर्धवृत्त में बैठे चार प्राचीन भूरे भूत, परिचय कराता वेताल

brief: A ring of golden sparks in the dark trembling as a branch cracks somewhere far; the Vetāla speaking softly to them with an open hand; you kneeling beside the smallest spark with Dādī's hand on your shoulder; Śuka close against your arm.

alt.en: A ring of golden sparks trembles in the dark while a grey spirit speaks softly and a child kneels beside the smallest
alt.hi: अँधेरे में काँपता सुनहरे स्फुलिंगों का घेरा, कोमलता से बोलता भूत, सबसे छोटे के पास बैठा बच्चा

brief: The small servant spirit crouched by the fire cooking in a little clay pot, one hand stirring, a thin smile; Dādī watching; Śuka sniffing the steam; the Vetāla in the background with an amused expression.

alt.en: A small servant spirit cooks by the fire in a clay pot while a parrot sniffs the steam
alt.hi: अलाव के पास मिट्टी की हाँडी में पकाता सेवक भूत, भाप सूँघता तोता

brief: A small stooped spirit in a patched servant's wrap shuffling into the firelight with an empty tray, baffled; the Vetāla pointing a lazy finger at him; Dādī explaining with two raised hands, one pointing away and one curling back to herself; Śuka cocking his head.

alt.en: A stooped servant spirit with an empty tray in firelight while an old woman gestures away and back
alt.hi: ख़ाली थाल लिए झुका सेवक भूत, दादी दूर और अपनी ओर इशारा करती हुई

brief: An old grove at night at the edge of a burning ground: a śiṃśapā tree with a long, thin ash-grey spirit hanging upside down from a branch, eyes closed, arms folded; below, you, Dādī and Śuka looking up; far back among the trunks the faint glow of a lantern and the tall silhouette of Lubdhaka; a tiny bright-red spirit pointing a long finger.

alt.en: A grey spirit hangs upside down in a tree while three travellers look up and a lantern glows far behind
alt.hi: पेड़ पर उलटा लटका भूरा भूत, नीचे तीन यात्री, पीछे दूर लालटेन की झलक

brief: Lubdhaka stepping out from between tree trunks with a raised lantern and a thin smile; the Vetāla hanging above him with a sweetly polite expression and a hand extended in welcome; Dādī gripping Śuka who stares with his beak open; long shadows.

alt.en: A tall man with a lantern steps out of the trees while a spirit hanging above him gestures a polite welcome
alt.hi: लालटेन थामे लम्बा आदमी पेड़ों से निकलता है, ऊपर लटका भूत विनम्र स्वागत करता है

brief: Lubdhaka setting a heavy leather purse on a tree root before you, his other hand on his satchel; the Vetāla grinning upside down; you standing firm with Dādī's hand on your shoulder and Śuka fluffed up; lantern light and long shadows.

alt.en: A man sets a heavy purse on a root before a child while a spirit grins upside down above
alt.hi: जड़ पर बच्चे के सामने भारी थैली रखता आदमी, ऊपर उलटा मुस्कराता भूत

brief: The burning-ground grove at night: a slim spirit of pale morning light leaning forward as if about to run, hair streaming ahead; the Vetāla hanging above with a sly look; you, Dādī and Śuka in the foreground; a glow of dawn beginning at the far edge of the trees.

alt.en: A pale spirit leans forward as if about to run while the Vetāla hangs above with a sly look
alt.hi: पीला भूत दौड़ने को आगे झुकता, ऊपर चालाक मुद्रा में वेताल

brief: The round white stone spirit stopping mid-pat with a thoughtful look; the Vetāla raising an eyebrow from his branch; Dādī and Śuka smiling; a faint glowing speech-mark shape in the air around the spirit's words.

alt.en: A smooth white stone spirit stops mid-pat in thought while a grey spirit raises an eyebrow above
alt.hi: सोच में थमा चिकना सफ़ेद पत्थर का भूत, ऊपर भौंह उठाता भूरा भूत

brief: A tiny perfectly round smooth white stone spirit rolled up to your feet at the foot of the śiṃśapā tree, patting itself as if looking for a place to attach something; the Vetāla hanging above, smiling; Dādī and Śuka looking down; firelight on the smooth stone.

alt.en: A small smooth white stone spirit at a child's feet patting itself, the grey spirit smiling above
alt.hi: बच्चे के पैरों के पास स्वयं को थपथपाता नन्हा चिकना सफ़ेद पत्थर का भूत, ऊपर मुस्कराता भूरा भूत

brief: The round white stone spirit rolling between three small stones scratched with a mark each, answering the Vetāla's questions; Śuka laughing; Dādī pointing at the three marks; the Vetāla leaning back satisfied.

alt.en: A white stone spirit rolls between three marked stones while a parrot laughs
alt.hi: तीन चिह्नित पत्थरों के बीच लुढ़कता सफ़ेद पत्थर-भूत, हँसता तोता

brief: The Vetāla seated straight on a root with a solemn expression; the paper-fan spirit unfolding his last fold, which carries three lines of writing; Dādī and Śuka listening; firelight.

alt.en: A grey spirit sits straight and solemn while a paper-fan spirit opens its last fold
alt.hi: सीधा और गम्भीर बैठा भूरा भूत, अन्तिम तह खोलता पंखे-सा भूत

brief: The paper-fan spirit lifting a folded hand to show three folds, each with a word, one for a figure who has gone, one for a said word, one for a finished thing; the Vetāla and Dādī watching; firelight.

alt.en: A paper-fan spirit shows three folds labelled with finished actions
alt.hi: पंखे जैसा भूत तीन तहें दिखाता जिन पर पूरी हो चुकी क्रियाओं के शब्द हैं

brief: A slim spirit like a folded paper fan unfolding in the firelight, each fold holding a line of tiny writing; the Vetāla speaking quickly with a hand pointing at the sky; Śuka looking lost; Dādī smiling and explaining.

alt.en: A paper-fan spirit unfolds in firelight as a grey spirit speaks quickly and a parrot looks lost
alt.hi: अलाव की रोशनी में खुलता पंखे-सा भूत, तेज़ बोलता भूरा भूत, उलझा हुआ तोता

brief: A hurrying figure crossing a moonlit clearing, murmuring to himself as he goes, a paper-fan spirit pointing at him from the roots; the Vetāla and Dādī watching; Śuka perched on a stump.

alt.en: A figure crosses a moonlit clearing murmuring as he goes while a paper-fan spirit points
alt.hi: चाँदनी में खुले स्थान को पार करती आकृति, बुदबुदाती हुई, पंखे जैसा भूत इशारा करता

brief: The paper-fan spirit folding his answer into a single word on one fold; Śuka testing words with a raised wing; Dādī smiling; the Vetāla listening with half-closed eyes; firelight.

alt.en: A paper-fan spirit folds an answer into one word while a parrot tests words
alt.hi: काग़ज़ी पंखे जैसा भूत उत्तर को एक शब्द में समेटता, शब्द परखता तोता

brief: The rose-mist pusher spirit with its dozen hands: one tilting a small boy's head towards a book, one lifting a spoon to a sleepy ghost's lips, one setting a foot on a path; the Vetāla pointing at each; Dādī laughing.

alt.en: A rose-mist spirit with many hands tilts a boy to a book, feeds a sleepy ghost and sets a foot on a path
alt.hi: गुलाबी धुंध का भूत अनेक हाथों से बालक को पुस्तक की ओर मोड़ता, ऊँघते भूत को खिलाता, राह पर पैर रखता

brief: A small round spirit of warm rose-coloured mist with a dozen tiny hands, like a starfish, bustling in: one hand pushing a book towards you, one a spoon, one setting a foot on a path; the Vetāla seated on a root beginning a tale with a raised finger; Dādī and Śuka watching.

alt.en: A rose-coloured spirit with a dozen tiny hands pushes a book, a spoon and a path towards a child
alt.hi: गुलाबी भूत दर्जन भर हाथों से बच्चे की ओर पुस्तक, चम्मच और राह धकेलता

brief: A quiet image of a small clay lamp whose flame stays steady while a cracked clay body beside it falls apart; ink-and-watercolour in the style of old Indian manuscripts, soft ivory paper.

alt.en: A steady lamp flame beside a cracked clay figure
alt.hi: दरार वाली मिट्टी की आकृति के पास स्थिर दीपक की लौ

brief: The twelfth tiny hand of the rose-mist spirit holding out a small clay cup, empty and very still; Śuka tilting his head; Dādī nodding; the Vetāla watching with half-closed eyes.

alt.en: A tiny hand holds out an empty clay cup very still while a parrot tilts his head
alt.hi: नन्हा हाथ ख़ाली मिट्टी का प्याला स्थिर बढ़ाए, सिर टेढ़ा करता तोता

brief: A burning-ground grove at night: a pale, almost see-through spirit walking backwards out of the dark, its edges fading like old ink, a trail of fading footprints behind it; the Vetāla hanging from the śiṃśapā tree yawning; Dādī and Śuka watching.

alt.en: A faint spirit walks backwards leaving fading footprints while the Vetāla yawns above
alt.hi: धुँधला भूत उलटा चलता मिटते निशान छोड़ता, ऊपर जम्हाई लेता वेताल

brief: The Vetāla seated on a tree root, folded like a long grey umbrella, eyes closed, telling a tale; Dādī and Śuka sitting before him; the faint backwards-walking spirit crouched beside; at the dark edge of the trees Lubdhaka leaning in to listen, the lantern low.

alt.en: A grey spirit sits on a root telling a tale while travellers listen and a man leans in from the dark
alt.hi: जड़ पर बैठा भूत कथा सुनाता, श्रोता यात्री और अँधेरे से झुकता एक आदमी

brief: An old king in a forest looking up at a tree where a corpse hangs and a lamp-lit face seems to speak; ink-and-watercolour illustration in the style of old Indian manuscripts, soft ivory paper.

alt.en: A king looks up at a talking corpse hanging in a tree
alt.hi: वृक्ष पर लटके बोलते शव को ऊपर देखता राजा

brief: A small quick spirit sitting on a tree stump with strings of tiny glass beads around its neck and wrists, sliding a bead onto a larger bead marked with a root; Śuka cocking his head; Dādī and the Vetāla watching; firelight on the glass.

alt.en: A bead-stringing spirit on a stump slides a glass bead onto a root while a parrot cocks his head
alt.hi: ठूँठ पर बैठा मनके पिरोता भूत, सिर टेढ़ा करता तोता

brief: The bead-spirit unwinding a long string of twenty-two glass beads across a mossy root, each bead catching the firelight, a different colour; Dādī leaning in to count them; Śuka pecking at the beads gently.

alt.en: A long string of twenty-two glass beads laid across a mossy root in firelight
alt.hi: काई लगी जड़ पर फैली बाईस काँच के मनकों की लम्बी माला

brief: The burning-ground grove at night: the Vetāla seated on a root rubbing his hands; a tiny round spirit of old paper in round spectacles with scrolls under both arms and one finger wagging at the sky; Dādī and Śuka beside you; a faint image in the smoke of a king and a hungry beggar on a lane.

alt.en: A tiny paper spirit with spectacles wags a finger at the sky while the Vetāla rubs his hands
alt.hi: चश्मे वाला नन्हा काग़ज़ी भूत आकाश की ओर उँगली हिलाता, हाथ मलता वेताल

brief: The Vetāla seated on a root reciting from memory with one finger raised, a faint glow of old palm-leaf lines in the air above him; Lubdhaka, tall and arms folded, sneering at the edge of the lamplight; you, Dādī and Śuka listening.

alt.en: A grey spirit recites an old verse while a tall man sneers at the edge of the lamplight
alt.hi: पुराना श्लोक सुनाता भूत, दीपक की रोशनी के किनारे व्यंग्य से मुस्कराता लम्बा आदमी

brief: The Vetāla seated on a root holding up a palm-leaf scroll with one finger on a line; a small basket of fruit at his feet; Dādī and Śuka beside you reading along; firelight.

alt.en: A grey spirit points to a line on a palm-leaf scroll beside a basket of fruit
alt.hi: पोथी की एक पंक्ति पर उँगली रखे भूत, पास में फलों की टोकरी

brief: The burning-ground grove at night: a small spirit shaped like a rolled-up storybook with stubby legs and a bright storyteller's turban drumming on its own spine with two fingers; the Vetāla seated on a root in a dramatic storytelling pose; you, Dādī and Śuka around a small fire.

alt.en: A rolled-up storybook spirit in a turban drums on its own spine while the Vetāla tells a tale
alt.hi: पगड़ी वाला लपेटी पोथी-सा भूत अपनी रीढ़ पर ताल देता, कथा सुनाता वेताल

brief: The Vetāla seated near a small fire telling a tale with a raised finger; the storybook spirit beating a drum-roll on his spine; Lubdhaka stopping at the edge of the firelight, pulled in by the drum; you, Dādī and Śuka around the fire.

alt.en: A grey spirit tells a tale by a fire while a man stops at the edge of the light
alt.hi: अलाव के पास कथा सुनाता भूत, रोशनी के किनारे रुका आदमी

brief: A flat stone in the grove with the Vetāla opening a worn ledger; a small round honey-brown spirit with ten tiny brass-handled drawers in his body hopping out and tugging drawers open, a pencil behind his ear; you, Dādī and Śuka watching; firelight.

alt.en: A drawer-bodied spirit tugs his drawers open beside a grey spirit with a worn ledger
alt.hi: दराज़ों वाला भूत अपने दराज़ खींचता, घिसी बही के साथ भूरा भूत

brief: A very small quick hand reaching out of an open drawer in the little spirit's body and snatching a pencil from behind his ear; the spirit squealing; the Vetāla amused; Dādī and Śuka laughing; firelight.

alt.en: A tiny hand from a drawer snatches a pencil from behind a startled spirit's ear
alt.hi: दराज़ से निकला नन्हा हाथ चौंके भूत के कान के पीछे से पेंसिल छीनता

brief: A tiny figure of mist spilling out of an opened drawer in the little spirit's body, turning on one foot with arms wide in a dance; the drawer-spirit staring at it in wonder; the Vetāla smiling; Dādī pointing; lamplight.

alt.en: A tiny mist dancer spills from a drawer in a little spirit's body
alt.hi: नन्हे भूत के दराज़ से बाहर बिखरता धुंध का नर्तक

brief: The ledger-spirit opening a small drawer with two fingers and lifting out a tiny silver needle; the Vetāla and Dādī leaning in to look; a pinprick of light at the needle's tip; firelight.

alt.en: A drawer-spirit lifts a tiny silver needle from his body while a grey spirit and an old woman lean in
alt.hi: दराज़ वाला भूत अपने शरीर से नन्ही चाँदी की सुई निकालता, पास झुके भूत और बुज़ुर्ग स्त्री

brief: A small plain ash-coloured spirit stepping out of an opened drawer, without any marks or ornaments, patting itself to check it is there; Dhātuka holding his ledger a little pale; the Vetāla and Dādī watching; firelight.

alt.en: A plain ash-coloured spirit steps out of a drawer and pats itself to check it exists
alt.hi: दराज़ से निकलता सादा राख-रंगा भूत, स्वयं को थपथपाकर जाँचता कि वह है

brief: A small spirit emerging from an open drawer, bowing and handing an apple to you, with two more apples in its other hand; Dhātuka beside it ticking a list; Dādī laughing; Śuka eyeing an apple.

alt.en: A small spirit from a drawer bows and hands over apples while a parrot eyes one
alt.hi: दराज़ से निकला नन्हा भूत झुककर सेब देता, तोता एक पर नज़र टिकाए

brief: Two small hands reaching out of two opened drawers: one cutting a thread with tiny scissors, the other holding a little scale; the Vetāla leaning back with a pleased look; Dādī reciting; Dhātuka ticking his ledger.

alt.en: Two tiny hands from open drawers, one cutting a thread, one weighing on a small scale
alt.hi: खुले दराज़ों से दो नन्हे हाथ: एक धागा काटता, एक तराज़ू पर तौलता

brief: A circle of small spirits with hands cupped to their ears around the Vetāla who is also listening, head tilted; Śuka hopping; Dādī smiling; Dhātuka ticking his ledger; firelight.

alt.en: A circle of small spirits cup their ears while a grey spirit listens with a tilted head
alt.hi: कान पर हाथ रखे नन्हे भूतों का घेरा, सिर टेढ़ा कर सुनता भूरा भूत

brief: The fifteenth statue: two stone figures standing back to back on one plinth, one holding a lotus, the other a bow; Śuka reading the long carved name on the plinth; Dādī with her hand on the stone; Lubdhaka's foreman copying it down.

alt.en: Two stone figures back to back on one plinth, one with a lotus and one with a bow
alt.hi: एक आसन पर पीठ से पीठ टिकाए दो पत्थर की आकृतियाँ, एक कमल लिए, दूसरी धनुष लिए

brief: The seventeenth statue holding a blue lotus; behind her a carved trio of small worlds like three bowls; Śuka looking from one to the other; Dādī counting on her fingers.

alt.en: A statue holds a blue lotus with three carved bowls behind her while a parrot looks from one to the other
alt.hi: नीला कमल थामे प्रतिमा, पीछे तीन कटोरे, उन्हें देखता तोता

brief: The eighteenth statue holding a clay pot, tapping it with one finger; a potter's wheel carved at her feet; Śuka cocking his head; Lubdhaka's foreman holding up his notebook to show a column of compounds.

alt.en: A statue taps a clay pot beside a carved potter's wheel while a man holds up a notebook of compounds
alt.hi: मिट्टी के घड़े पर थपथपाती प्रतिमा, कुम्हार का चाक, समासों की पुस्तिका दिखाता आदमी

brief: The sixteenth statue holding a staff, a king's crown carved at her feet; Lubdhaka's foreman writing in his notebook; Dādī shaking her head gently and tapping the word; Śuka reading over his shoulder.

alt.en: A statue holds a staff while an old woman gently corrects a man's notebook
alt.hi: दण्ड थामे प्रतिमा, आदमी की पुस्तिका सुधारती दादी

brief: The twentieth statue holding a small carved lantern whose stone flame is steady; Dādī pointing at a row of three carved words on the plinth; Śuka squinting at them; the lamps of the hall flickering.

alt.en: A statue holds a stone lantern beside three carved words on the plinth
alt.hi: पत्थर की लालटेन थामे प्रतिमा, आसन पर तीन खुदे शब्द

brief: The nineteenth statue with a pale blue throat carved into the stone, a faint crescent moon over her brow; Dādī touching the throat and pointing outward; Śuka looking up the hall; Lubdhaka's foreman reading from his notebook.

alt.en: A statue with a pale blue carved throat while an old woman touches it and points outward
alt.hi: हल्के नीले कण्ठ वाली प्रतिमा, उसे छूकर बाहर इशारा करती दादी

brief: The twenty-first statue wearing a long garland of carved stone flowers, each a different shape, trailing to the floor; Śuka counting on his claws; Dādī tracing the garland from its last flower back to its first; Lubdhaka's foreman following her finger.

alt.en: A statue wears a long stone garland while an old woman traces it from the last flower to the first
alt.hi: लम्बी पत्थर की माला पहने प्रतिमा, अन्तिम फूल से पहले तक उसे खोजती दादी

brief: A long garland of carved stone flowers laid along a table, each flower holding one tiny Sanskrit syllable-group; a brass lamp beside it; ink-and-watercolour illustration, soft ivory paper.

alt.en: A long stone garland laid on a table, each flower holding a word
alt.hi: मेज़ पर फैली पत्थर के फूलों की लम्बी माला, हर फूल में एक शब्द

brief: The twelfth statue humming with her mouth closed and her hand lightly against her nose, a hint of resonance; Śuka listening with a tilted head; Dādī smiling; lamplight on carved stone.

alt.en: A statue hums with her hand lightly at her nose while a parrot listens
alt.hi: मुँह बन्द कर गुनगुनाती प्रतिमा, हाथ नाक के पास; सुनता तोता

brief: The eleventh statue, smooth and smiling calmly, with her palm turned up; Śuka looking at the stone beside her; Dādī tracing a letter in the dust with one finger; the long hall lit by oil lamps.

alt.en: A smooth smiling statue with her palm turned up while an old woman traces a letter in the dust
alt.hi: चिकनी मुस्कराती प्रतिमा, हथेली ऊपर किए; धूल में अक्षर खींचती दादी

brief: The tenth statue with sharp sandstone edges holding a small stone bell, an inscription on her plinth; Śuka peering at it; Dādī pointing at a single letter; Lubdhaka's foreman holding up a lamp behind them; early evening light.

alt.en: A statue with sharp edges holding a stone bell while a parrot peers at the inscription on her plinth
alt.hi: तीखे किनारों वाली प्रतिमा पत्थर की घण्टी थामे, आसन के अभिलेख को झाँकता तोता

brief: Dādī telling the legend with a hand raised; behind her, a faint painted vision of a sage by a river looking up at a hunter who has lowered his bow, and a pair of cranes, one fallen, one crying; Chandikā listening with her drum in her lap; Śuka perched wide-eyed on the throne; Lubdhaka at the back, no longer smiling.

alt.en: Dādī tells a legend while a faint vision shows a sage, a hunter and two cranes
alt.hi: दादी कथा सुनाती हैं, पीछे ऋषि, व्याध और दो सारस की धुँधली छवि

brief: A small grey-blue stone spirit with a drum sitting on the carved arm of a golden throne, tapping with both hands; Dādī crouching to talk to her; Śuka on the throne's back tilting his head at a line of carved verse on the seat; Lubdhaka at the back in the shadows.

alt.en: A tiny stone spirit with a drum sits on a throne's arm while a parrot studies a carved line
alt.hi: सिंहासन की बाँह पर ढोल लिए नन्ही पत्थर की भूत, खुदी पंक्ति देखता तोता

brief: A stone balance with two pans at the foot of a spiral stair; Dādī laying a palm-leaf verse on one pan and small stone grains on the other; Vṛttikā drifting past; Śuka reading the pans; Lubdhaka at a distance, taking notes.

alt.en: A stone balance at the foot of a stair, a verse in one pan and grains in the other
alt.hi: सीढ़ी के नीचे पत्थर की तराज़ू, एक पलड़े में श्लोक और दूसरे में दाने

brief: Behind a slid-open stone panel, a tall thin spirit of pale smoke drifting in a ring around the golden throne, her long sleeves trailing, one hand counting on her fingers; Dādī and Śuka watching from the opening; Chandikā's small drum resting on the throne's arm; warm light.

alt.en: A smoky spirit drifts in a ring around a golden throne counting on her fingers
alt.hi: धुएँ जैसी भूत सोने के सिंहासन के चारों ओर घेरे में उँगलियों पर गिनती हुई

brief: A round stone vault at the foot of a spiral stair; a small ink-dark spirit tangled in a long cord of tiny knotted letters, knots at every joint; a carved verse on the wall with no gaps between words; Dādī kneeling beside the spirit; Śuka on the carved ledge reading; at the top of the stair, a tall figure in a dark coat in silhouette.

alt.en: A small spirit sits tangled in a cord of knotted letters beneath a carved verse
alt.hi: खुदे श्लोक के नीचे गाँठ-गाँठ अक्षरों की डोरी में उलझी नन्ही भूत

brief: The round vault wall covered in carved verses, each with small notes in faded ink all round it; Śuka on a ledge reading the notes round one verse aloud; Dādī beside him following with a finger; the small spirit Ślokikā with her cord slack on her lap, listening; warm lamplight.

alt.en: A vault wall of carved verses with faded margin notes while a parrot reads them aloud
alt.hi: खुदे श्लोकों वाली दीवार पर फीके हाशिये के नोट, ज़ोर से पढ़ता तोता

brief: The thirteenth statue holding a thin chisel; Lubdhaka's foreman crouched at an inscription on the plinth with his lamp beside him, frowning; Dādī kneeling beside him and pointing to one letter; Śuka on the plinth.

alt.en: A statue with a thin chisel while an old woman points at one letter and a frowning man crouches by his lamp
alt.hi: पतली छेनी वाली प्रतिमा, एक अक्षर की ओर इशारा करती दादी, दीपक के पास झुका उलझा आदमी

brief: The fourteenth statue with a long carved line running across her stone base; Dādī taking the chisel from the statue's hand and marking gaps between words; Lubdhaka's foreman standing back with his arms folded; Śuka reading over her shoulder.

alt.en: An old woman marks gaps between words in a carved line across a statue's base
alt.hi: दादी प्रतिमा के आसन पर खुदी पंक्ति में शब्दों के बीच अन्तराल बनाती

brief: Three palm-leaf lines lying across a stone base, each with small gaps marked in red between the words; a brass lamp at one side; ink-and-watercolour in the style of old manuscripts.

alt.en: Three palm-leaf lines with red marks between the words
alt.hi: तीन ताड़पत्र-पंक्तियाँ, शब्दों के बीच लाल चिह्न

brief: The thirty-second statue, the last, stern-faced, with a very small hand held up showing two fingers; at her feet the throne itself, bare and plain; Dādī and Śuka looking up at her; Lubdhaka's foreman at the back, quiet.

alt.en: The last statue with a stern face and two raised fingers before a plain stone throne
alt.hi: कठोर मुख, उठी दो उँगलियों वाली अन्तिम प्रतिमा, सादे पत्थर के सिंहासन के सामने

brief: The thirty-two statues standing in a ring around a lit stone throne; Lubdhaka with one foot on the first step and his foreman beside him; a small basalt spirit holding out a scroll with a line on it to the travellers; Dādī and Śuka stepping forward; warm light from inside the throne.

alt.en: Thirty-two statues ring a lit throne as a man puts a foot on the step and a small spirit holds out a line
alt.hi: प्रकाशित सिंहासन के चारों ओर बत्तीस प्रतिमाएँ, सीढ़ी पर पैर रखता आदमी, पंक्ति बढ़ाती नन्ही भूत

brief: The thirty-first statue holding a small stone bowl in which a golden sun rises; carved lotuses opening along her plinth; Dādī pointing at the sun; Śuka watching; early gold light in the hall.

alt.en: A statue holds a stone bowl with a rising sun while carved lotuses open along her plinth
alt.hi: पत्थर के कटोरे में उगता सूर्य थामे प्रतिमा, आसन पर खिलते कमल

brief: The thirtieth statue holding a long unrolled scroll that trails behind her; Śuka reading it aloud with a raised wing; Dādī smiling; Lubdhaka's foreman following the words with his finger.

alt.en: A statue holds a long scroll while a parrot reads aloud and a man follows with his finger
alt.hi: लम्बा पत्र थामे प्रतिमा, ज़ोर से पढ़ता तोता, उँगली से पढ़ता आदमी

brief: The twenty-fourth statue holding a small purse of coins that clink; Dādī counting a few on her palm; Śuka trying words aloud; Lubdhaka's foreman eyeing the purse hungrily.

alt.en: A statue holds a purse of clinking coins while a man eyes it hungrily
alt.hi: खनकते सिक्कों की थैली थामे प्रतिमा, लालच से देखता आदमी

brief: The twenty-fifth statue holding a pair of stone scales that tilt gently; Dādī pointing at the beam; Śuka perched on one pan which sinks slightly; Lubdhaka's foreman watching the scales hold his breath.

alt.en: A statue holds stone scales tilting gently while a parrot perches on one pan
alt.hi: पत्थर का तराज़ू थामे प्रतिमा, एक पलड़े पर बैठा तोता

brief: The twenty-third statue holding a shallow bowl of still water that shivers; Dādī touching the rim; Śuka looking into the water at three faces reflected: a man, a god, a stone; lamplight on the water.

alt.en: A statue holds a bowl of still water shivering, with three reflected faces
alt.hi: ठहरे जल का कटोरा थामे प्रतिमा, जल में तीन प्रतिबिम्ब

brief: The twenty-second statue holding a small bronze mirror in which a row of names glows instead of a face; Dādī leaning in to read them; Śuka reading over her shoulder; Lubdhaka's foreman copying names into his notebook.

alt.en: A statue holds a small mirror showing a row of glowing names instead of a face
alt.hi: छोटा दर्पण थामे प्रतिमा, चेहरे की जगह चमकते नामों की पंक्ति

brief: The seventh statue with a finger lifted to her lips, a fine mist of breath leaving her mouth and drifting up in the cold air; Śuka testing words with a raised wing; Dādī listening; Lubdhaka's foreman at a distance holding a lamp.

alt.en: A stone statue with a finger at her lips, a trail of mist leaving her mouth
alt.hi: होंठों पर उँगली रखे प्रतिमा, मुँह से उठती धुंध की रेखा

brief: The ninth statue with a calm, steady expression, one hand lifted as if to hold a thought; Śuka checking words on his claws; Dādī nodding; the earlier eight statues behind her in the lamplight; the first stars outside the hall.

alt.en: A calm statue with one hand lifted as the lamp-lit hall fills with earlier statues
alt.hi: शान्त प्रतिमा, एक हाथ उठाए, दीपक-प्रकाशित कक्ष में पिछली प्रतिमाएँ

brief: The eighth statue with her lips slightly parted as if hissing, a faint curl of breath; Śuka counting on his claws; Dādī pointing at three inscribed words on a pillar; Lubdhaka's foreman holding his lamp higher.

alt.en: A statue with parted lips faintly hissing while a parrot counts and an old woman points at an inscribed pillar
alt.hi: हल्की फुफकारती प्रतिमा, गिनता तोता, अभिलेख वाले स्तम्भ की ओर इशारा करती दादी

brief: The fifth statue holding a carved stone oar upright, a faint wave pattern carved on her base; Śuka tilting his head; Dādī pointing at the small curl on a rubbing of an inscription; morning light.

alt.en: A stone statue holds an oar upright while a parrot tilts his head at an inscription rubbing
alt.hi: पतवार थामे पत्थर की प्रतिमा, अभिलेख की छाप देखता तोता

brief: The fourth statue holding a polished bronze mirror, in which the three travellers are reflected; Śuka peering into it; Dādī smiling; the earlier three statues behind; Lubdhaka's foreman in the background with a notebook.

alt.en: A stone statue holds a mirror in which three travellers are reflected
alt.hi: दर्पण थामे पत्थर की प्रतिमा, जिसमें तीन यात्रियों का प्रतिबिम्ब दिखता है

brief: The second statue, a woman holding a conch, with Śuka on Dādī's shoulder counting on his claws; Lubdhaka's foreman looking on with arms folded; the first statue beside her with a lotus; morning light on the dig.

alt.en: A stone statue holding a conch while a parrot counts on his claws and a foreman watches
alt.hi: शंख थामे पत्थर की प्रतिमा, पंजों पर गिनता तोता, देखता मुखिया

brief: A hill above Ujjayinī at dawn: workmen's tents and ropes around a half-uncovered stone throne ringed by thirty-two weathered statues of women; the first statue, holding a lotus, close to the viewer; Lubdhaka's foreman frowning at her; you, Dādī and Śuka at the edge of the dig.

alt.en: A dig site with a stone throne ringed by thirty-two statues, the first holding a lotus
alt.hi: पत्थर के सिंहासन के चारों ओर बत्तीस प्रतिमाएँ, पहली कमल थामे

brief: The sixth statue standing with open empty hands, a closed carved door behind her base; Śuka narrowing his eyes; Dādī pointing at an inscription with two words kept apart by a small gap; Lubdhaka's foreman scratching his head.

alt.en: A statue with open empty hands before a closed carved door, a parrot narrowing his eyes
alt.hi: ख़ाली खुले हाथों वाली प्रतिमा, बन्द नक्काशीदार द्वार के सामने, आँखें सिकोड़ता तोता

brief: The third statue holding a small drum, her fingers poised to tap; the first two statues beside her; Śuka squinting up at her; Lubdhaka's foreman wiping his brow; morning light.

alt.en: A stone statue with a small drum poised to tap while a parrot squints up
alt.hi: छोटा ढोल थामे पत्थर की प्रतिमा, ऊपर देखता तोता

brief: A dark second alcove with a round stone seal cut with a single word and small marks; Dādī pointing at the word; the quarter-visible silver spirit leaning forward; Śuka on her shoulder; Lubdhaka behind with a hand resting on the seal, face calm and unreadable.

alt.en: A round seal with a word and small marks, a spirit leaning forward, a man's hand on the seal
alt.hi: शब्द और छोटे चिह्नों वाली गोल मुहर, आगे झुकती भूत, मुहर पर टिका एक हाथ

brief: The third alcove opened a hand's breadth, with a plain line of script over it; Dādī kneeling and chalking a single root-letter on the stone floor, a neat row of seven flat stones laid beside it like the steps of a wall; the silver spirit nearly whole, watching; Lubdhaka stepping in from the cave mouth with his satchel; Śuka on the stone row.

alt.en: A woman chalks a root on the floor beside a row of seven laid stones as a man steps in
alt.hi: फर्श पर धातु लिखती स्त्री और सात बिछे पत्थरों की कतार, भीतर आता आदमी

brief: A mountain cave with four alcoves in the far wall, three dark and the last one glowing behind a sealed round stone; fourteen short lines of script carved above it in a neat row; a small silver spirit of whom only a crescent quarter is visible sitting beside the stone; Dādī and Śuka looking up at the carving; Lubdhaka at the cave mouth with one hand raised, commanding.

alt.en: A glowing alcove behind a sealed stone with fourteen short carved lines above it
alt.hi: बन्द पत्थर के पीछे चमकता आला और उसके ऊपर खुदी चौदह छोटी पंक्तियाँ

brief: A mountain cave whose walls are carved with lines of script, lit by small lamps; four alcoves in the far wall, three dark and one glowing; a small amber spirit with cupped hands sitting in the first alcove; Dādī and Śuka at the front; at the cave mouth behind, a tall figure in a dark coat in silhouette.

alt.en: A cave with script-carved walls and four alcoves, a small spirit with cupped hands in the first
alt.hi: लिपि खुदी दीवारों और चार आलों वाली गुफा, पहले आले में हाथ जोड़े नन्ही भूत

brief: An old woman in a cream cotton sari sits on a low stool reading a palm leaf aloud under a banyan tree; a green parrot on a branch above her listens with its head tilted; warm morning light.

alt.en: An old woman reads a palm leaf under a tree while a parrot listens
alt.hi: पेड़ के नीचे ताड़पत्र पढ़ती वृद्धा, सुनता तोता

brief: A poor young man in a patched kurta standing before a richly dressed merchant in a market lane; the merchant looking down at a small dead mouse on the ground and laughing, the young man pointing at it with a thoughtful look; warm old-India watercolour.

alt.en: A poor young man and a laughing merchant looking at a dead mouse
alt.hi: ग़रीब युवक और मरे चूहे को देखकर हँसता व्यापारी

brief: The young man at a shady crossroads outside the town with a water pot and a basket of roasted chickpeas, giving them to tired woodcutters who rest under a tree with bundles of logs beside them; late afternoon light.

alt.en: A young man shares water and chickpeas with tired woodcutters at a crossroads
alt.hi: चौराहे पर थके लकड़हारों को पानी और चने देता युवक

brief: The young man in good clothes standing proudly at the door of his own busy shop, holding up a small golden mouse; the old merchant Viśākhila smiling beside his daughter who is garlanding him; neighbours cheering.

alt.en: A prosperous young man holds up a golden mouse beside a smiling merchant and his daughter
alt.hi: सुनहरा चूहा थामे धनी युवक, पास में मुस्कुराता व्यापारी और उसकी कन्या

brief: A village house at night: two dusty travelling scholars with cloth bundles sitting in the courtyard with a lamp; in the lane beyond, a travelling actor dancing to a drum, torch-lit; a small boy of seven watching from the doorway, head tilted, listening; his mother in the doorway beside him.

alt.en: Two travelling scholars in a courtyard at night as a small boy listens to a drum in the lane
alt.hi: रात में आँगन में दो यात्री विद्वान्, गली में मृदंग सुनता नन्हा बालक

brief: The mother standing at the door of the small house at night with her hand on her small son's shoulder, looking up at the night sky where faint golden lines of script and a soft glow gather above the roof; the two scholars at her feet looking up in wonder; the boy listening with his head tilted.

alt.en: A mother and her small son look up at a golden glow in the night sky, two scholars beside them
alt.hi: माता और नन्हा बालक रात के आकाश में सुनहरी आभा देखते, पास में दो विद्वान्

brief: The courtyard of a poor mud-walled house in Pāṭaliputra: the thin teacher Varṣa seated on swept ground speaking, three boys sitting cross-legged before him with a small boy in front, eyes closed, listening; townsfolk gathering at the gate with folded hands; a royal messenger with a gift tray arriving.

alt.en: A teacher speaks to three pupils in a poor courtyard as townsfolk gather with folded hands
alt.hi: गरीब आँगन में तीन शिष्यों को पढ़ाते गुरु, हाथ जोड़े जुटते नगरवासी

brief: A quiet courtyard school in Pāṭaliputra: a thin earnest young man in plain white with a shaved head and a bundle of palm leaves sitting a little apart from the other pupils, slow and sorrowful; the teacher Varṣa's wife at a doorway making a gentle but firm gesture of dismissal; warm old-India watercolour.

alt.en: A thin young man sits apart from other pupils while the teacher's wife gestures him away
alt.hi: दूसरे शिष्यों से अलग बैठा पतला युवक, उसे विदा करती गुरुपत्नी

brief: A high Himālayan slope with snow peaks and dark pines: the thin young man seated cross-legged on a flat rock beside a tiny fire, eyes closed in austerity, snow on his shoulders; above him on the peak a serene ascetic figure with a thin crescent moon in his matted hair, hand raised in blessing; drifting cloud; soft gold light.

alt.en: A thin young man sits in austerity on a snowy slope while a serene ascetic with a crescent moon blesses him
alt.hi: बर्फ़ीली ढलान पर तप करता पतला युवक, अर्धचन्द्र वाले शान्त तपस्वी का आशीर्वाद

brief: A courtyard in Pāṭaliputra at dusk: two scholars facing each other, one older and assured, one thin and pale; a ring of silent listeners; above, a dark sky with a great shape of cloud and the faint outline of an ascetic with a crescent moon raising a hand; an unrolled palm-leaf manuscript on the ground between the two debaters.

alt.en: Two scholars debate in a courtyard as a great shape appears in the dusk sky
alt.hi: आँगन में शास्त्रार्थ करते दो विद्वान्, साँझ के आकाश में एक विराट आकृति

brief: A deep dry well in a palace courtyard: a lean grey-bearded minister in a dusty cream robe being slowly hauled up on a rope by two guards, blinking in the light; a calm tall scholar-minister in white standing at the rim watching; a proud king in red and gold looking on from a balcony in the background.

alt.en: A grey-bearded minister is hauled from a deep dry well while a calm scholar watches at the rim
alt.hi: गहरे सूखे कुएँ से खींचा जाता धूसर दाढ़ी वाला मन्त्री, किनारे पर शान्त विद्वान्

brief: The wide pale Gaṅgā at morning with a hand with five spread fingers rising from the water; a proud king in red and gold on the brick steps pointing in astonishment; a calm tall scholar-minister beside him holding up two fingers of one hand; a lean grey-bearded man a little behind, looking downcast.

alt.en: A hand with five fingers rises from the river as a scholar holds up two fingers
alt.hi: नदी से उठता पाँच उँगलियों वाला हाथ, दो उँगलियाँ उठाए विद्वान्

brief: A lean grey-bearded minister bowing deeply before a proud king in a pillared hall, his bent back like a reed in a breeze; behind him through an arch the calm tall scholar-minister watching him with narrowed eyes; a long reed bending in a vase on a table in the foreground.

alt.en: A grey-bearded minister bows low like a reed before a proud king as a scholar watches
alt.hi: घमण्डी राजा के आगे सरकण्डे की तरह झुकता मन्त्री, देखता विद्वान्

brief: A lean bearded poet in white sitting under a banyan tree in a wild forest, a palm leaf on his knee, writing with his own finger in a shallow bowl of dark red; a stack of finished leaves beside him; small blue-lit spirits listening between the trunks; a tall dignified blue spirit, Kāṇabhūti, nearby; soft evening light.

alt.en: A poet under a banyan writes on a palm leaf with a dark red liquid while blue spirits listen
alt.hi: बरगद के नीचे गहरे लाल द्रव से ताड़पत्र पर लिखता कवि, सुनती नीली भूत

brief: A pillared court hall in a stone city on a river; a proud young king in red and gold with a pearl necklace holding up a palm-leaf book at arm's length with a sneer; two young disciples in pale saffron standing back, the tall one stiff, the round-faced one near tears; sunlight through the pillars.

alt.en: A king holds a palm-leaf book at arm's length with a sneer as two young disciples stand back
alt.hi: पत्तों की पुस्तक को दूर से उपहास में थामे राजा, पीछे खड़े दो शिष्य

brief: A small clearing on a rocky rise at dusk; a lean bearded poet in white feeding palm leaves one by one into a square stone fire-pit, holding up a leaf as if reading aloud; two young disciples in pale saffron standing close, wet-eyed; a quiet ring of deer, boars and birds sitting very still, listening; thin smoke curling upward.

alt.en: A poet burns palm leaves one by one in a fire-pit as deer and birds sit listening in a ring
alt.hi: अग्निकुण्ड में एक-एक ताड़पत्र जलाता कवि, घेरे में चुपचाप सुनते मृग और पक्षी

brief: The clearing at dawn: the fire burnt low, grey ash in the stone pit; the young king, humbled, kneeling before the lean bearded poet and holding out both hands; the poet offering a single small bundle of palm leaves; two disciples behind; a few small blue-lit ghosts at the clearing's edge, arriving too late, watching from between the trees.

alt.en: A humbled king kneels and receives a last bundle of palm leaves from a poet beside a burnt-out fire
alt.hi: बुझी आग के पास घुटनों पर राजा, कवि से ताड़पत्रों की अन्तिम गठरी लेता हुआ

brief: A young queen in a deep-red sari asleep on a low bed in a lamp-lit palace chamber, one hand on her belly; at the foot of the bed, a tall figure of matted hair, ash-smeared body and a crescent moon, smiling kindly with a trident held loosely, as if in a dream; moonlight through lattice windows.

alt.en: A queen sleeps with a hand on her belly while a kindly figure with a crescent moon appears in her dream
alt.hi: पेट पर हाथ रखे सोती रानी, स्वप्न में अर्धचन्द्रधारी दयालु आकृति

brief: A palace lying-in chamber with latticed windows and lamps; a young queen in deep red lying back with a tired smile, a tiny baby in saffron cloth in her arms; a handsome king in pale gold bending over them, wonder and joy on his face; a soft glow around the baby.

alt.en: A king bends over a queen and her newborn son with wonder and joy
alt.hi: रानी और नवजात पुत्र पर आश्चर्य और आनन्द से झुका राजा

brief: A palace courtyard at dusk; the king holding up his baby son in saffron cloth toward the open sky, the queen beside him; pale flower petals falling from above like rain; drummers on the rooftops; lamps lit along the walls; a faint luminous cloud above the courtyard where a voice seems to come from.

alt.en: A king lifts his baby son to the sky as flower petals fall and drums sound
alt.hi: आकाश की ओर पुत्र को उठाता राजा, गिरती फूलों की पंखुड़ियाँ और बजते नगाड़े

brief: A sunlit palace garden beside a lotus pool; a small laughing child in saffron playing with six boys of different sizes in plain bright clothes, a ball and a toy cart on the grass; a king and a queen watching from a pillared verandah, smiling; a glowing palm leaf resting on the verandah rail.

alt.en: A small laughing prince plays with six boys by a lotus pool while the king and queen watch
alt.hi: कमल-सरोवर के पास छह बालकों के साथ खेलता हँसता छोटा राजकुमार
